provincial Document 136 implementation plans, mechanism-energy ratios and contract terms, 2027 incremental auction results, whether green-certificate revenue overlaps with mechanism energy, and the effect of the 2027 spot rules on capture prices.

openItems.topic: Zero-carbon parks and green direct connection
openItems.text: the second national park list, the park construction/evaluation guideline annex (core vs. guiding indicators), provincial direct-connection rules (Guangdong/Zhejiang/Inner Mongolia/Jilin/Shandong/Liaoning draft), the provincial average-load-factor parameter, green-certificate ownership and transfer for self-used direct-connection energy, and the exact adoption dates of Docs 650 (2025-05-21 vs. 05-30) and 688 (2026-05-14 vs. 05-20).
the conversion formula in each province, treatment of multi-circuit supply that keeps the two-part tariff, and whether export energy keeps any mechanism-price eligibility.

the final text and effective date of the 2026-09-30 national draft; the 2026 North/East China and southern-region revisions; the Shanxi 2025 document number; Northeast/Northwest 2024-2026 rules; the clause numbers behind Shandong's late-AGC, parameter-change and plan-curve penalties; whether provincial assessment prices and caps converge; renewable- and storage-specific primary-frequency and AGC clauses.

final 2026 storage statistics; the 136 GW vs. 144.7 GW end-2025 calibre gap; conflicting 2025 grid-forming annual vs. cumulative figures; the full texts of GB/T 47968-2026 and GB/T 47655-2026; whether any national document mandates grid-forming (the circulated 2026-04-01 claim and 30% target are unverified); provincial grid-forming ratios and compensation rules; exact GB/T 51048-2025 separation/compartment clauses; the project boundary behind "flow battery below 2 CNY/Wh"; 300 MW CAES actual efficiency and cost; sodium-ion utility-scale cycle-life and safety data; the 15 incidents of 2026 H1; the 2% lithium-battery consumption tax pass-through; whether Doc. 114 capacity pricing differentiates grid-forming or long-duration storage; inertia/voltage-support/black-start ancillary-service payment rules.

the final 2026 spot rules (whether the 76-article draft survives), the secondary price-cap and LMP clauses, whether renewable+storage joint bidding is adopted; final retailer/risk-control/credit rules and the actual guarantee ratio and dynamic-limit method; provincial clearing granularity (96 vs. 288 points) and settlement formulas; whether the new rules change backtest baselines or model benchmarks; public reconciliation cases and loss-sharing arrangements between aggregators, retailers and resources.

openItems.topic: Demand response, V2G and flexible resources
openItems.text: actual 2026 provincial DR dispatch and settlement data (most provinces publish calls but not settlement); Guangdong Doc. 233 and Jiangsu 2026 fast-response implementation details; whether Doc. 241 covers 30 or 32 projects; the post-2026-11-01 wording of DR baselines; V2G pilot mid-term evaluation; bidirectional-charger standards and battery-warranty coverage; how transmission/distribution charges apply to reverse discharge; the 2030 V2G 50 GW and VPP 50 GW targets' provincial allocation; whether DR and VPP double-count the same resources in national statistics.

whether the final retailer measure keeps the 1 fen/kWh × 1-10 formula, the CNY 2 million floor, the insurance restriction and the spot-real-time universal-service price; whether the risk-control measure creates a risk reserve or fund; final credit indicator weights, coefficient mapping and repair deadlines; how the 15/5 working-day objection and next-cycle retro-adjustment interact with stricter provincial rules; provincial deviation bands, penalty prices and responsibility sharing; whether the 2026-10 spot draft keeps the six risk types, three-level intervention, daily clearing/monthly settlement and price-difference direction; the timing and content of the Retail Market Basic Rules; the formal document number and penalties of the 2026-06-08 retail notice; universal-service provider selection, cost allocation and user choice window; the treatment of unresolved contracts on retailer exit; related-party volume caps; credit treatment of storage/VPP; green-power and mechanism-energy treatment in deviation and settlement; cross-provincial settlement risk and guarantees; negative-price deviation and retail package design; insurance exclusions, deductibles and claim order; 2027 contract negative-spread risk and regulatory tolerance.

Australia's Reliability Panel recommended a 99.997% standard for 2028-32 in its April 2026 final report, pending the AEMC decision; the NEM's 2026-27 price bands apply only to that financial year; Germany's AgNes grid-fee reform has a draft determination from 2026-10 and a final determination due 2027-01-01, with rules from 2029; the StromVKG capacity-mechanism auctions and contract terms are still taking shape after EU approval; UK REMA, TMO4+ delivery and LDES final parameters are pending; Italy's second MACSE auction (2026-11-24) and capacity-market rules may change; EU market-coupling and balancing-platform changes (SDAC/SIDC, PICASSO/MARI) may alter gate times and products. Re-check the relevant rule before quoting any market.

whether REMA adopts zonal pricing (the 2026 decision rejected it) and the final TMO4+ queue rules; T-4/T-1 auction parameters for 2030/31 and later; the LDES cap-and-floor final parameters due in autumn 2026 and the first allocation round; BM skip-rate and pay-as-bid reform; CfD eligibility for co-located storage; MHHS migration timing; TNUoS reform by 2029 and BSUoS treatment.

the MACSE second auction result (2026-11-24) and later round sizes; capacity-market parameters and 2028 de-rating factors; FER X auction schedules and NZIA eligibility; the 277 GW connection-application queue and regional permitting (aree idonee); PUN and zonal-price volatility; MSD/MB product changes as storage penetration rises.

CIS Tender 10 results are still pending; the §118(6) exemption only applies to storage commissioned by 2029-08-04; AgNes final determination is due 2027-01-01; the two 2026 StromVKG auctions reportedly exclude battery storage while the 2027 new-capacity tender is open with ≥10 hours; WDRM/FCAS revenue assumptions must be re-based on current prices; all worked examples in the storage module are synthetic (grade D), not investment advice.

the first capacity auction under Orden TED/966/2026 (timing and clearing price) and the EU state-aid terms; whether the RDL 7/2026 flexible-access reserve and RD 997/2025 grid-forming conditions are implemented in full; 2026 negative-price hours and solar capture rates; the 2025-04-28 blackout investigation outcome; conversion of the permitted/pending storage pipeline.

whether a capacity mechanism follows the completed study; SDE++ 2027 parameters and any battery-specific category; rollout of the 2026-07-01 priority framework and ATR85 non-firm contracts; TenneT's 4 GW-by-2030 storage connection plan; the aFRR 4-hour contract migration; the end of net metering (2027-01-01) and its effect on behind-the-meter storage; congestion-fee design.

battery de-rating (13.39% is a grade-C figure, 2030 delivery-year main auction only; do not mix with the 95% used in the 2027 T-1 top-up), the 2030 vs. 2029 auction outcomes, foreign participation, NFOŚiGW delivery by end-2028 and Article 62 deductions, MARI accession, the 2026 OZE non-price criteria, negative-price hours and the coal phase-down.

the Belgian CRM price unit and Y-4/Y-2/Y-1 results, nuclear extension and state aid, offshore build-out, Nordic mFRR EAM/PICASSO rollout in Sweden/Norway, the effektreserv auction, the Swedish bidding-zone review (report due 2027-01-29), negative-price hours and the four countries' different entry rules.

the ERCOT RTC+B performance and any ORDC changes; PJM 2028/29 BRA delivery, the 2029/30 BRA and ELCC parameter updates; CAISO RA slice-of-day implementation, EDAM expansion and FMM/RTD changes; ITC/FEOC/Section 301 implementation details and the August 2026 grid-equipment executive order; PJM/CAISO queue reform and co-location rules; state permitting and fire-code adoption.

the FY2030 capacity auction, de-rating factors and round-4 LTDA cap/results (schedule published 2026-10-09); implementation of the ≥6-hour threshold and the ~90% clawback; EPRX product migration and cap changes; the connection-study cap enforcement and queue processing; the JEPX spot cap rulebook wording; SII grant amounts; FEFTA review practice for storage SPVs.

the final NZIA implementing acts and IAA status; national implementation of NIS2 and the EU Battery Regulation delegated acts (battery passport data fields, carbon-footprint methodology); the exact fire-code adoption path in each US state and UK/Netherlands/Poland local permits; whether FDI screening practice changes for storage SPVs; all country-specific entries not verified line by line are written as "local permits" in the module and must be checked against the original text.

the first Spanish auction under TED/966/2026 (no convocatoria as of 2026-11-11; timing and price); the Italian MACSE second auction result (2026-11-24) and later rounds; the German StromVKG auction terms and whether batteries are admitted; the Belgian CRM price unit (resolved 2026-11-11: €27.3k/MW·yr, grade A, Elia 2025-10-30); the Swedish effektreserv re-auction; the Australian CIS Tender 10 result and state-scheme stacking rules; PJM 2029/30 BRA and ELCC updates; Japan FY2030 CM and round-4 LTDA; all five worked examples in the capacity module are synthetic (grade D).

PICASSO/MARI accession dates for the remaining TSOs (Poland MARI, Sweden/Norway PICASSO, etc.); UK BM and DC/DM/DR product changes; Italy MSD/MB product migration; Spain aFRR/mFRR product changes; Australia FCAS market design and very fast FCAS; ERCOT RTC+B and ORDC changes; PJM/CAISO ancillary product reforms; Japan EPRX product migration and cap changes; storage prequalification rules and SOC/performance tests are country-specific and must be checked against the current rulebook.

openItems.topic: Storage revenue modelling and data sources
openItems.text: the data-access terms, API changes and redistribution limits of each platform (ENTSO-E, EPEX, Nord Pool, Elexon, GME, OMIE, PSE, AEMO, CAISO, ERCOT, PJM, JEPX); settlement-granularity changes; whether 5-minute or 15-minute data are final or preliminary; degradation and RTE test standards; the treatment of capacity/ancillary co-optimisation; all four worked examples are synthetic (grade D) and must not be used as investment benchmarks.

whether EU GO and UK REGO move toward mutual recognition; AIB membership changes; the treatment of GO vintage and 12-month validity in each registry; the final EU Battery Regulation carbon-footprint rules and whether green certificates can be used (currently not recognised for that purpose); the legal status of 24/7/hourly matching claims and granular certificates; CfD/CIS/state-scheme stacking and clawback terms; tolling contract terms are private and the module only provides a checklist; all five worked examples are synthetic (grade D).

2025 installed capacity and annual average price are now backfilled for eleven markets, but Spain's installed capacity remains blocked (REE/ESIOS automation returns 403), Poland's and ERCOT's local-currency annual averages are still open, Australia's and the US annual negative-price hours are missing, and capture rates, interconnection durations and de-rating coefficients are incomplete; the Poland 2031 delivery-year auction, the next Belgian CRM round, the outcome of the Swedish bidding-zone review (report due 2027-01-29), the French PL-4 first round and the MHHS migration dates are not confirmed; 22 grade-C tickets are now a resolution ledger: 8 closed on 2026-11-11 (including the Belgian CRM price upgraded to A and the incorrect German battery-ban wording withdrawn), 14 still pending with next-review dates; the remaining gaps carry explicit due dates and must not be filled with estimates.

the PL-4 2030-31 first auction date and parameters, the PPI exemption applications accepted before 2026-11-23, the first actual VNU settlement in 2027, the end-2026 grid-framework reform, the battery-queue conversion rate (14 GW/180 projects vs ~30 GW access rights), the de-rating coefficients applied to batteries in PL-1/PL-4, and the 2027 CRE tender calendar; the first-auction €28,182.99/MW is a 151-day delivery-period price and must not be annualised without stating the conversion.
